narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Segmented Document"**

Khaali presents a person's details as one printed document: labelled segments ruled by hairlines, condensed capitals for values, tracked monospace labels and tabular figures. The world borrows the visual grammar of a travel document (segment rules, tear line, barcode strip, mono field labels) as style only; it never borrows the subject. It is dense, legible and flat, read at a glance rather than browsed.

Colour is near-monochrome: cool paper ground, white panels, ink text and controls, a slate data panel for the document list. One alert yellow carries all the attention in the system; it marks change (a value Khaali set for you, a row being filled) and the pressed button, and nothing else.

Settings follow the reader's colour scheme; the profile document stays paper-white in both themes, and the in-page panel is always light because it sits over government websites.
keyCharacteristics: One segmented profile document: hairline-ruled cells, mono label over condensed-caps value.
Square 2px corners on everything; no pills, no soft cards.
Flat panels; depth only for the floating in-page panel.
Alert yellow means "changed" or "pressed", never decoration.
Lit-until-noticed: changed rows stay yellow with an UPDATED tag until the person looks at them.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow is spent only on change (lit, warn), the pressed or focused control, and selection. It never fills a static surface, heading or icon.

rules.name: The Paper Stays Paper Rule
rules.body: The profile document and the in-page panel are always light, whatever the theme; only the surrounding settings chrome goes dark.

rules.name: The Label Over Value Rule
rules.body: Every datum is a mono uppercase label sitting directly above its value. Labels name the field plainly ("Born", "PIN", "District"); they are never decorative captions or section eyebrows.

rules.name: The Figures Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Numbers a person must check digit by digit (PIN, mobile, dates, IDs) set in Khaali Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow. Only a surface floating over someone else's page may lift.

dos: **Do** set every datum as a mono uppercase label (11px, 0.08em) directly above a condensed-caps or mono value.
**Do** keep every corner at 2px and every border at 1px.
**Do** reserve signal yellow (#FFD400) for changed rows, the pressed button, focus outlines and selection.
**Do** keep changed values lit until the person focuses them, then let them settle in place rather than disappear.
**Do** set PINs, phone numbers, dates and IDs in Khaali Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** keep the profile document and the in-page panel light in both themes.
**Do** use dashed 1px borders only to mark something empty or missing.
donts: **Don't** use travel or boarding vocabulary anywhere in the UI: no passenger, gate, flight, boarding, seat, trip, check-in, departure or board. The travel document is a style source only.
**Don't** use plane icons, airport codes or any travel imagery.
**Don't** use rounded cards, pill buttons or pill tags.
**Don't** put drop shadows on panels in the page; only the floating in-page panel lifts.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or use yellow on static surfaces, headings or icons.
**Don't** add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings; mono labels name fields, not sections.
